limitations: One repetition per fusion. Model startup is included in first-query time; later queries reuse the loaded worker. Docker quotas 4 CPU/40 GiB; some measurements overlap builds/other local experiments, so timings are not dedicated-host benchmarks. Initial two runs terminated the worker directly; final implementation shuts it down gracefully. All six runs have zero reranking fallbacks.
